Represent only selection facts needed by the single C004 router for AI-poise development.

definition_of_done: Bootstrap/update paths use one routing owner.
Changing explicit scope/facts can recompute the route deterministically.
No target-repository policy engine or path-resolution override is introduced.
contract.goal: Implement one AI-poise routing owner that derives applicable scoped rules, shipped skills and registered checks from explicit task/change facts and paths.

It may read branch-local AGENTS.md, skills and references from the explicitly supplied AI-poise checkout when those branch-local instructions are part of the work.
Return applicable rule/skill/check identities, missing inputs and stage/result contract facts needed by downstream owners.
Persist only the routing result required for handoff/replay; do not create a second lifecycle.

definition_of_done: Confirmed requirement gaps are covered by focused tests/documentation.

contract.goal: Audit the existing AI-poise IDE skill against useful ERP jetbrains-ide requirements and fill only confirmed gaps; do not ship a second IDE skill or router.

IDE/AST operations receive the concrete AI-poise checkout path they should inspect.

Unknown paths are surfaced with a repairable diagnostic.
Selection feeds existing verification owners and does not become a finalizer.
contract.goal: Select focused AI-poise verification methods from task requirements, explicit diff paths and AI-poise test-package impact using C004, C015 and C016.

Interpret changed paths against the explicitly supplied AI-poise checkout and C016 package map.

Recompute when task scope or relevant diff facts change.

definition_of_done: Known AI-poise boundary violations fail with actionable diagnostics.
Valid boundaries pass in focused tests.
No generic language-dispatch analyzer layer is added.
contract.goal: Gate AI-poise architecture-boundary violations at the authoring stage using existing or explicitly registered AI-poise Python checks, without creating a generic multi-language analyzer.
requirements: Limit analysis to boundaries owned by the AI-poise Python codebase and its documented architecture.
Operate on the explicitly supplied code checkout/path and report file/symbol/rule diagnostics.
A violation blocks delivery from the authoring stage but remains fixable in the same Task/stage.
Do not migrate C029.2/C029.3 as hidden prerequisites or impose PHP/JS analyzers on unrelated projects.

constraints: Migration improves AI-poise, not all target projects.

Focused tests plus bounded smoke, never full-suite discovery.
